courses.overview: 由端點事件、偵測證據與核准回應連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect endpoint events, detection evidence and approved response to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 安全資訊事件管理
related.why: 可移植「端點覆蓋」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from endpoint coverage; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.transfer: 可移植「端點覆蓋」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from endpoint coverage; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理端點事件、偵測證據與核准回應；「安全資訊事件管理」主要處理日誌正規化、事件關聯與可用性，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes endpoint events, detection evidence and approved response; Security information and event management emphasizes log normalization, event correlation and availability. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「企業端點偵測與回應」與「安全資訊事件管理」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「時間排序」的對照方法至「時區與偏差」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Enterprise endpoint detection and response and Security information and event management flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from time ordering to timezone and skew, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

practiceEn: Draw Enterprise endpoint detection and response and Network intrusion-detection engineering flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from time ordering to protocol decoding, redefining inputs, units and observations.
